issues.legal_issue: A claimant seeking recognition as a tenant of agricultural land was entitled to khatedar-tenant status under the applicable statutory tenancy regime.
material_facts: The claimant brought a suit seeking a declaration of tenant status over the land.
The trial revenue court dismissed the suit, while revenue appellate authorities recognized the claimant as a khatedar tenant on different statutory grounds.
The High Court reversed the revenue authorities’ decision.
The Supreme Court held that, whichever party’s factual version was accepted, the claimant was entitled to khatedar-tenant status by virtue of the statutory amendment to the tenancy law.
issues.conclusion: The claimant was declared to be a khatedar tenant of the land, and the High Court’s judgment was reversed.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 19 of the Rajasthan Tenancy Act, as amended by Amendment Act 7 of 1959, the claimant was entitled to khatedar-tenant status. The judgment cites no earlier cases.

predicates.tenant_status_declaration_proceeding: The claimant brought a proceeding seeking a declaration of tenant status in agricultural land.
predicates.amended_tenancy_law_covers_claimant: The amended statutory tenancy regime applied to the claimant’s claimed tenancy.

issues.definition: When a claimant seeks a declaration of tenant status and the amended tenancy regime applies to the claimed tenancy, the claimant is a khatedar tenant.

issues.legal_issue: A claimant declared to be a khatedar tenant was required to pay compensation after conceding liability on the statutory basis.
material_facts: At the end of argument, the claimant offered to pay compensation calculated on the basis provided by Section 19(4), without prejudice to contentions under Section 15.
The Court directed the claimant to pay compensation after the appropriate revenue authority fixed it.
issues.conclusion: The claimant was directed to pay compensation on the Section 19(4) basis, with the amount to be fixed by the appropriate revenue authority and paid thereafter; the claimant’s Section 15 contentions were preserved.
issues.legal_principle: Section 19(4) provided the basis for calculating compensation. The claimant’s concession to pay on that basis was accepted without prejudice to contentions under Section 15. The judgment cites no earlier cases.

predicates.tenant_status_declaration_proceeding: The claimant brought a proceeding seeking a declaration of tenant status in agricultural land.
predicates.claimant_conceded_statutory_compensation: The claimant offered to pay compensation calculated on the applicable statutory basis.
predicates.respondent_accepted_concession: The respondent accepted the claimant’s offer to pay compensation.

issues.definition: In a tenant-status declaration proceeding, when the claimant offers to pay compensation on the statutory basis and the respondent accepts, the claimant must pay compensation after the appropriate authority fixes the amount.
